Name: E's Teas
Author: cel10e
Description:
[size=5]About the mod[/size]
This is a mod that adds a bit more depth to tea processing and brewing in Stardew Valley. It is designed to add a bit of flavor to the vanilla experience, now that the tea bush was added in Stardew Valley 1.4!

The mod has not been tested alongside other tea mods such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2607]Tea Time[/url] and PPJA (Project Populate JSON Assets). Please feel free to report compatibility/incompatibility in the comments here on Nexus, or to me at cel10e#4446 on Discord. :)

[b]Coming soon:[/b] a compatibility pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2080]Better Artisan Good Icons[/url], to give each brewed tea a unique look!

[size=5]Install instructions[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Install Json Assets[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Install the Producer Framework Mod[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.
[*]Run the game and play!
[/list]

[size=5]Uninstall instructions[/size][list=1]
[*] [b]Remove and trash all items created by this mod[/b]. This includes the Tea Pot and Tea Oxidizer machines and any brewed teas.
[*]Remove the mod from your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Edited the Tea Pot recipe to take 1 Marble instead of 1 Tea Set, since I had forgotten they aren't available in the Furniture Catalog [facepalm]
